description: This file contains the PHP source code for the class 'ProductPurchased', which is a controller in the Opencart admin extension, specifically for reporting on products purchased. It defines methods for displaying, saving configuration, and generating reports related to product purchase data.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: Controller class for handling the Product Purchased report in the admin extension of Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the form for configuring the product purchased report.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report configuration settings.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the product purchased report page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of the product purchased report data as a view.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the product purchased report data based on filters for AJAX requests or internal use.
